answer: Invariant: no identity counts until it burns a resource clones cannot copy. Each applicant submits a fresh pigment sample shot under randomized light, hashed to a physical fingerprint; duplicate or near-duplicate hashes die, so bulk-minted keys fail. Then a random member must compose a short sonnet naming that applicant and a violet nonce, bonding slashable stake behind it. Swarms copy code, never distinct pigment nor bonded verse.
